input_route: A / ideal camera + ideal root + separately registered ideal hub-axis plane
reference_role: historical image-derived loaded shape; held fixed, not truth

candidate_structural_point.d_scope: candidate model-axis to ideal axis-normal plane; not yet accepted structural measurement

use_history: all development/previously inspected; no blind test
observations: previously reviewed second-run RGB FBU/contours; reverify actual decoded RGB hashes before use, source fields/calibration checked against bundle

candidate_model.section: fixed chord/thickness/twist from static v2, minimal rotation transport from reference tangent to current tangent
candidate_model.time_parameterization: none: independent diagnostic states, no trajectory fitting

loss: existing bidirectional projected_contour_loss; per-frame equal camera weights; empty terms invalid, not zero residual

ambiguity_rule.comparison: native-pixel average bidirectional mean-distance <= best+3 px; report finite-grid d span
ambiguity_rule.tolerance_source: exploratory historical boundary uncertainty, not calibrated noise or engineering tolerance

elastic_delta_reason: no independent unloaded reference input permitted to estimator
stop_conditions: unmapped structural reference blocks structural metric acceptance; candidate d may be diagnostic only
calibration_uncertainty: ideal input conditional; finite grid excludes calibration/time errors and does not establish global identifiability
